title: Admit and retain immutable task exchange capture and explicit fetch
outcome: Admit and retain immutable task exchange capture and explicit fetch
acceptance: Enabled main-checkout exchange admits existing materialized shared paths through its own inspector without weakening B2 replay; it pins project/store/profile, repository/admin/local branch and effective configured destination/ref, complete SQLite candidate and cut, prior export baseline, committed Git tree, selected index stages/flags and raw worktree, verified import basis or explicit none, reconciliation base and incoming commit before integration.

Capture and explicit fetch use S0's bounded runner and independent private Git-admin state/object-retention refs; retries preserve exact operation, candidate, branch basis and pinned incoming commit despite later SQLite writes or B1 pruning. Explicit absent-first-use and full preserved rebaseline replace unknown bases; equality never fabricates a successful import.

Owned tests cover committed-but-unimported edits concurrent with SQLite changes, target/profile/branch and selected-path drift, missing/divergent bases, linked/sparse checkout refusal, whole-candidate protected disclosure before new state, explicit authorized Git fetch through S0 with its deadline, cancellation and stdout/stderr limits, and interrupted capture/fetch/pin recovery while preserving unrelated index/code/task/SQLite state. These subprocess limits do not enforce transfer-byte, fetched-history, Git-object-expansion, disk-space or aggregate retained-state quotas; no enforced quarantine receive budget is claimed. Failure or interruption preserves the exact operation and available recovery evidence without treating a partial or unknown fetch as a retained incoming candidate or successful import.
No shared-file integration, commit/push, SQLite import/canonical receipt, TermAl relay or implicit Git authority is introduced; any durable-store requirement is presented to Greg before coding.
